mapper.select:
/*selectSellerMpStClosingList*/
SELECT A.PO_NO /* 발주번호 */ , A.GR_NO /* 출고번호 */ , A.DESCRIPTION /* 품목명 */ , A.SPECIFICATION /* 규격 */ , A.ITEM_QTY /* 출고수량 */ , A.AGENT_PRICE /* 단가 */ , A.AGENT_ITEM_AMT /* 총금액 */ , A.GR_DATE /* 출고일자 */ , #{st_buyer_code} AS BUYER_CODE /* 고객사코드 */ , #{st_buyer_name} AS BUYER_NAME /* 고객사명 */ FROM ICOMGRDT A /* 구매사별 입고정보 */ , ICOMPODT C /* 발주 제품정보 */ WHERE 1=1 AND A.BUYER = C.BUYER AND A.PO_NO = C.PO_NO AND A.PO_SEQ = C.PO_SEQ AND A.STATUS <> 'D' AND C.WAREHOUSE_CODE = #{st_com_code} AND A.BUYER = #{st_buyer_code} AND C.PROCESS_TYPE = '3' AND A.GR_DATE BETWEEN #{st_from_date} AND #{st_to_date} ORDER BY PO_NO

/*selectSellerMpStClosingList_v2*/
SELECT X.AP_CLOSE_MONTH /* 마감월 */ , (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = X.BUYER) AS BUYER_NM /* 고객사명 */ , X.PO_NO /* 발주번호 */ , X.BUYER_ITEM_NO /* 고객사품번 */ , X.DESCRIPTION /* 품목명 */ , X.SPECIFICATION /* 규격 */ , X.ITEM_QTY /* 수량 */ , X.AGENT_PRICE /* 단가 */ , X.AGENT_ITEM_AMT /* 총금액 */ , X.GR_DATE /* 출고일자 */ , X.DELIVERY_DATE /* 납품일자 */ , (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = X.ADD_USER_ID) AS KEP_USER_NM /* 담당자명 */ , (SELECT PHONE_NUMBER FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = X.ADD_USER_ID) AS PHONE_NUMBER /* 연락처 */ , X.AP_TAX_BILL_NO /* 세금계산서번호 */ , X.BUYER /* 고객사코드 */ FROM ( -- 일반 출고 데이터 SELECT GRDT.AP_CLOSE_MONTH , GRDT.BUYER , GRDT.PO_NO , GRDT.BUYER_ITEM_NO , GRDT.DESCRIPTION , GRDT.SPECIFICATION , SUM(GRDT.ITEM_QTY) AS ITEM_QTY , GRDT.AGENT_PRICE , SUM(GRDT.AGENT_ITEM_AMT) AS AGENT_ITEM_AMT , GRDT.GR_DATE , MAX((SELECT MAX(DELIVERY_DATE) FROM ICOMIVDT WHERE BUYER = GRDT.BUYER AND PO_NO = GRDT.PO_NO AND PO_SEQ = GRDT.PO_SEQ AND STATUS != 'D' AND DELIVERY_DATE IS NOT NULL)) AS DELIVERY_DATE , GRDT.AP_TAX_BILL_NO , (SELECT MAX(ADD_USER_ID) FROM KEPTAPDT WHERE TAX_BILL_NO = GRDT.AP_TAX_BILL_NO) AS ADD_USER_ID FROM ICOMGRDT GRDT WHERE GRDT.AGENT = #{st_agent} /* 공급사코드 */ AND GRDT.AP_CLOSE_MONTH = #{st_close_month} /* 마감월 */ AND GRDT.PROCESS_TYPE != '3' /* HUB 거래가 아닌 일반 거래 */ GROUP BY GRDT.AP_CLOSE_MONTH , GRDT.BUYER , GRDT.PO_NO , GRDT.BUYER_ITEM_NO , GRDT.DESCRIPTION , GRDT.SPECIFICATION , GRDT.AGENT_PRICE , GRDT.GR_DATE , GRDT.AP_TAX_BILL_NO
UNION
-- HUB 거래 출고 데이터 SELECT GRDT.AP_CLOSE_MONTH , GRDT.BUYER , GRDT.PO_NO , GRDT.BUYER_ITEM_NO , GRDT.DESCRIPTION , GRDT.SPECIFICATION , SUM(GRDT.ITEM_QTY) AS ITEM_QTY , GRDT.AGENT_PRICE , SUM(GRDT.AGENT_ITEM_AMT) AS AGENT_ITEM_AMT , GRDT.GR_DATE , MAX((SELECT MAX(DELIVERY_DATE) FROM ICOMIVDT WHERE BUYER = GRDT.BUYER AND PO_NO = GRDT.PO_NO AND PO_SEQ = GRDT.PO_SEQ AND STATUS != 'D' AND DELIVERY_DATE IS NOT NULL)) AS DELIVERY_DATE , GRDT.AP_TAX_BILL_NO , (SELECT MAX(ADD_USER_ID) FROM KEPTAPDT WHERE TAX_BILL_NO = GRDT.AP_TAX_BILL_NO) AS ADD_USER_ID FROM ICOMGRDT GRDT , WMSIVDT IVDT WHERE 1=1 AND GRDT.AGENT IN (SELECT CODE FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'HUB') /* HUB 공급사 */ AND GRDT.AP_CLOSE_MONTH = #{st_close_month} /* 마감월 */ AND GRDT.PROCESS_TYPE = '3' /* HUB 거래 */ AND GRDT.BUYER = IVDT.BUYER AND GRDT.PO_NO = IVDT.PO_NO AND GRDT.PO_SEQ = IVDT.PO_SEQ AND GRDT.INV_NO = IVDT.INV_NO AND GRDT.INV_SEQ = IVDT.INV_SEQ AND IVDT.AGENT = #{st_agent} /* 실제 공급사코드 */ GROUP BY GRDT.AP_CLOSE_MONTH , GRDT.BUYER , GRDT.PO_NO , GRDT.BUYER_ITEM_NO , GRDT.DESCRIPTION , GRDT.SPECIFICATION , GRDT.AGENT_PRICE , GRDT.GR_DATE , GRDT.AP_TAX_BILL_NO ) X ORDER BY X.BUYER , X.PO_NO
